name: Objektas H (Namas)

source.document_kind: pasiūlymas 2026-09-03 (xlsx); tiles + statybvietės rows carry unit prices but NO quantities

notes_for_evaluator: OUT-OF-SAMPLE (second batch, 2026-09-05): never used to tune a rule, prompt, concept or calibration. Single-storey house interior by a designer studio, 8 A4 pages: išdėstymo planas WITH patalpų eksplikacija (11 rooms, bendras plotas 143,27 m²), rozečių, apšvietimo, vandens įvadų, lubų, sienų dažymo (designer's own figure: 'Sienų dažai 320 m²'), grindų dangų, pertvarų planai. No išklotinės, no durų/langų žiniaraštis. Contractor quote covers GKP, glaistymas/dažymas, santechnika; tiles and site costs are priced per unit without quantities. gt_dimensions empty.

walls_paint_total_m2.notes: Founder rule 2026-09-05: painted ceilings = the eksplikacija total (Is viso), always; walls = his combined glaistymas/dazymas line minus that total. Ceilings and walls are checked separately. Designer sienu dazymo planas states 320 m2; the two humans differ by 19 %. Previous derivation (- GKP 137,71 = 275,17) is superseded.

ceiling_paint_total_m2.notes: Founder rule 2026-09-05: painted ceilings = the eksplikacija total (Is viso), always; walls = his combined glaistymas/dazymas line minus that total. Ceilings and walls are checked separately. Billed GKP lubos are 137,71 - the 5,56 m2 difference is GKP scope, not painted ceiling.
